Hi Evelyn / Marissa / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Good conversation — the team was especially interested in the latency profile and the prefix-caching workflow you showed.

We spoke internally and want to move to a 6-week trial focused on two main use cases: 1) clinical note summarization (batch ingestion from our anonymized S3 staging bucket) and 2) synchronous coding-assist for a small team of 10 clinical reviewers.

High-level asks:
- A simple success criteria doc we can sign off on
- A proposed timeline and ownership for onboarding, data ingestion, and evaluation
- Any immediate blocking technical requirements (network/IPs, certs, S3 permissions)

I attached a quick checklist from our side with expected datasets and timelines (cumulus_trial_checklist.xlsx).

Proposed kickoff: are you available next Tuesday (Apr 10) for a 30–45m onboarding call?

Thanks,
Samir

Hi Samir — great to hear. I pulled together a compact POC activation plan that matches the two use cases you outlined and includes measurable success criteria, milestones, and ownership. See summary below — I also attached a one-page playbook for your security and procurement team.

POC objective:
- Validate end-to-end throughput and quality for clinical note summarization (offline batch) and evaluate latency/accuracy for live coding-assist with a 10-person reviewer team.

Success criteria (pass/fail checkpoints):
1) Batch summarization: achieve >= 85% agreement with your internal gold set on extractive highlights (sample N=500) and processing rate >= 10k notes/day with median per-note time <= 2.5s (server-side token compute).
2) Coding-assist: average response latency <= 400ms under a 10-user sustained load (50 concurrent small prompts across the group) and F1 >= 0.80 on coding suggestions vs labeled ground truth (sample N=200).
3) Stability: < 1% error/timeout rate across both flows for two consecutive weeks during the trial window.

Proposed 6-week timeline (owners):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): contracts/NDAs, S3 access, network whitelisting (Samir ops + Ben).
- Week 1: Kickoff + baseline functional test (Evelyn owner for onboarding, Ben for infra).
- Weeks 2–3: Batch ingestion + iterative tuning; weekly quality checkpoints (Marissa owner for evaluation, Samir to provide gold labels).
- Weeks 4–5: Coding-assist live simulation, load tests, and latency tuning (Ben and engineering).
- Week 6: Final acceptance run, handoff notes, and decision review.

Deliverables:
- Weekly short status notes (one slide) and a mid-trial quality report at end of Week 3.
- Final report with metrics, costs, and recommended next steps.

Immediate technical checklist (high priority):
- Add the following IPs to your allowlist: 52.14.120.32/28, 34.213.48.0/24 (Ben, I included these in the infra doc).
- Provide an S3 read-only role ARN for a staging bucket and a sample manifest file.
- Confirm whether you prefer hosted (Redwood API) or Dedicated reserved pool for predictable latency — we recommend Dedicated for the live coding-assist pilot.

If this looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff for Apr 10, 10:00–10:45 PT and circulate a calendar invite with agenda + owners.

best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
